Pre-existing, outside 006: status prints the not-configured message only when knowledge-config.yml is absent. A fresh install scaffolds the file with sources: null, so status shows an empty table plus a sync hint instead of pointing to configure.

Outside 006, unreleased: a0e7287 tracks .agents/skills/* (7 files), but neither .extensionignore nor .gitattributes export-ignore lists .agents/. --dev installs copy them (CI included), and the next release archive would ship them to every consumer. validate-extension.sh leak regex does not cover .agents/. Fix: add .agents/ to both files and to the leak check. Local --dev installs also copy the untracked skills-lock.json and ignored .mcp.json.

Outside 006, pre-existing: the Source Slug Generation snippet in commands/speckit.knowledge.sync.md (L24-L27, rendered into the sync and status skills) puts a # comment after each line-continuation backslash, so run literally it is a bash syntax error; an agent must strip comments to get the slug. Fix separately: move the comments above the pipeline.

Update to the .agents/ concern: 4a750a6 (same branch, not a 006 commit) also tracks skills-lock.json at the root. The T018 candidate built exactly like git archive therefore carries 19 files, 8 of them unrelated (.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md x7, skills-lock.json). Add .agents/ and skills-lock.json to .extensionignore and .gitattributes export-ignore, and to the validate-extension.sh leak regex, before the next release.

SC-004 CI half pending: no pull request run exists yet, so Install smoke test and Install smoke test (minimum spec-kit) are verified only by running their validate.yml steps locally. Confirm both on the PR before merge, then add the new check to the main ruleset.

Before publication (FR-010): stock macOS still lacks GNU timeout, so a real status reachability run on macOS stays blocked until the separately tracked portability fix lands and passes. Windows (WSL or Git Bash) remains an untested platform claim. At release, move the README --from tag to the manifest version.

Security, pre-existing, outside 006, high priority: url and path_filter validation rejects only a leading - and checks the prefix, so shell metacharacters (; $( ) backticks, spaces) pass, and the command snippets interpolate <url>/<pattern> unquoted. A merged config change could then run commands on every teammate and hook-driven sync, an exposure the README trust model does not list. Fix in its own feature: quote every interpolated value in the snippets and reject shell metacharacters in all three validation blocks together.
